title: "Chess on Chain"
tagline: "Chess on Chain" refers to the integration of chess gameplay with blockchain technology. NFT's are given on chess stats
description:
Chess on Chain" addresses the problem of easily shareable chess statistics. Traditionally, recording and sharing chess game data, such as move sequences, wins, losses, and rankings, can be cumbersome and fragmented. Players often rely on manual record-keeping or third-party chess platforms, which may not offer efficient sharing options.With "Chess on Chain," these statistics are seamlessly recorded and stored on the blockchain. Each move and game outcome is transparently logged, providing players with a reliable and immutable record of their chess performance. These statistics become easily shareable as they are stored as part of the blockchain's public ledger.

Players can now effortlessly share their chess accomplishments, game histories, and rankings with others by simply providing a unique blockchain address or token ID associated with their chess profile. This innovation eliminates the need for complex data exports or relying on centralized platforms to access and share chess statistics.
